menuRound.title: Menus skipped for this draw
menuRound.hint: Skip a menu without recording it as eaten. All entries with the same name are skipped together.
menuRound.minimum: At least 2 entries must remain available to spin again.
menuRound.resetHint: Temporary skips clear when candidates or meal exclusions change, and when you reload the page.
